/-!
# Conjecture 9.47

by I. V. Protasov

Is it true that every scattered compact can be homeomorphically embedded into the
space of all closed non-compact subgroups with $E$-topology of a suitable locally
compact group?

Here a *compact* is a compact Hausdorff space, and a space is *scattered* if every
nonempty subset has a point which is isolated in it. For a topological group $G$,
the $E$-topology (Protasov) on the lattice $L(G)$ of closed subgroups of $G$ is the
topology in which a closed subgroup $H$ has the basic neighbourhoods
$$E(H, U, K) = \{X \in L(G) : X \cap K \subseteq HU \text{ and } H \cap K \subseteq XU\},$$
where $U$ ranges over the neighbourhoods of the identity and $K$ over the compact
subsets of $G$. On a locally compact group it coincides with the Chabauty topology.
Locally compact groups are assumed to be Hausdorff.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

/--
A topological space `X` is *scattered* if every nonempty subset `A` of `X` has a point

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 54]
theorem isScattered_iff_forall_preperfect {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] :
    IsScattered X ↔ ∀ A : Set X, Preperfect A → A = ∅ := by
  simp only [IsScattered, Preperfect, ← not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
  refine forall_congr' fun A => ⟨fun h hA hne => ?_, fun h hne => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := h hne
    exact hx' (hA x hx)
  · by_contra h'
    push_neg at h'
    exact h h' hne

@[category test, AMS 54]
theorem isScattered_of_discreteTopology (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [DiscreteTopology X] : IsScattered X := by
  intro A ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, -⟩, hyx⟩ := accPt_iff_nhds.mp h {x} (isOpen_discrete _ |>.mem_nhds rfl)
  exact hyx hy

def eNhd (H : ClosedSubgroup G) (U K : Set G) : Set (ClosedSubgroup G) :=
  {X | (X : Set G) ∩ K ⊆ (H : Set G) * U ∧ (H : Set G) ∩ K ⊆ (X : Set G) * U}
blocks.docstring:
The basic $E$-neighbourhood
$$E(H, U, K) = \{X \in L(G) : X \cap K \subseteq HU \text{ and } H \cap K \subseteq XU\}$$
of a closed subgroup `H` of `G`, determined by a subset `U` (a neighbourhood of the

justification.closest_existing_considered: TopologicalSpace.vietoris (Vietoris topology on Set α / Compacts) — a different topology (Vietoris, not Chabauty/Fell/E), and Mathlib explicitly does not put it on closed sets or subgroups.
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.47».eNhd
justification.why_needed: The basic E-neighbourhood {X | X ∩ K ⊆ H * U ∧ H ∩ K ⊆ X * U} of a closed subgroup H, the building block of Protasov's E-topology; not in Mathlib.

theorem mem_eNhd_self (H : ClosedSubgroup G) {U : Set G} (hU : (1 : G) ∈ U) (K : Set G) :

def eTopology : TopologicalSpace (ClosedSubgroup G) where
  IsOpen O := ∀ H ∈ O, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (1 : G), ∃ K : Set G, IsCompact K ∧ eNhd H U K ⊆ O
  isOpen_univ _ _ := ⟨univ, univ_mem, ∅, isCompact_empty, subset_univ _⟩
  isOpen_inter O₁ O₂ h₁ h₂ H hH := by
    obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁, K₁, hK₁, hO₁⟩ := h₁ H hH.1
    obtain ⟨U₂, hU₂, K₂, hK₂, hO₂⟩ := h₂ H hH.2
    refine ⟨U₁ ∩ U₂, inter_mem hU₁ hU₂, K₁ ∪ K₂, hK₁.union hK₂, fun X ⟨hX₁, hX₂⟩ => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨hO₁ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hO₂ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left).trans
        (hX₁.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_left))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left).trans
        (hX₂.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_left))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans
        (hX₁.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_right))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans
        (hX₂.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_right))
  isOpen_sUnion S hS H := by
    rintro ⟨O, hO, hHO⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, K, hK, h⟩ := hS O hO H hHO
    exact ⟨U, hU, K, hK, h.trans (subset_sUnion_of_mem hO)⟩
blocks.docstring:
Protasov's $E$-topology on the lattice $L(G)$ of closed subgroups of a topological group
`G`: a set `O` of closed subgroups is open iff every `H ∈ O` has a basic neighbourhood
`eNhd H U K ⊆ O`, where `U` is a neighbourhood of the identity and `K` is a compact
subset of `G`.

justification.closest_existing_considered: TopologicalSpace.vietoris / Compacts.topology (Vietoris), EMetric.Closeds (Hausdorff-metric topology, metric spaces only) — none is the Chabauty/E-topology on closed subgroups of a topological group.
justification.name: Kourovka.«9.47».eTopology (and the scoped TopologicalSpace (ClosedSubgroup G) instance)
justification.why_needed: Protasov's E-topology on the lattice of closed subgroups is not in Mathlib or FormalConjecturesForMathlib; ClosedSubgroup G carries no topology in Mathlib. Defined as: O is open iff every H ∈ O has a basic neighbourhood eNhd H U K ⊆ O with U ∈ 𝓝 1, K compact.

subset of `G`.

    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left).trans
        (hX₁.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_left))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left).trans
        (hX₂.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_left))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans
        (hX₁.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_right))
    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans
        (hX₂.trans (mul_subset_mul_left inter_subset_right))

    rintro ⟨O, hO, hHO⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, K, hK, h⟩ := hS O hO H hHO

claims.decomposer_note: Single yes/no question with quantifier structure ∀ scattered compact (Hausdorff, per Russian convention) space X, ∃ a locally compact (Hausdorff) group G and a topological embedding of X into the subspace of non-compact closed subgroups of G, where the 'E-topology' is Protasov's topology on the lattice of closed subgroups (basic neighbourhoods of H given by {X : X∩K ⊆ HU and H∩K ⊆ XU} for U a neighbourhood of 1 and K compact), which for locally compact groups coincides with the Chabauty/Fell topology; the E-topology is not in Mathlib and would have to be defined.
claims.reviewer_why: All eight candidates state the slot with the correct shape (answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ scattered compact Hausdorff X : Type, ∃ Hausdorff locally compact topological group G, ∃ f : X → {non-compact closed subgroups of G}, IsEmbedding f). c01 was chosen because it (i) defines the E-topology directly from Protasov's neighbourhood base {X : X∩K ⊆ HU ∧ H∩K ⊆ XU} (U ∈ 𝓝 1, K compact) as a genuine TopologicalSpace structure with the axioms proved, matching the source's named object rather than substituting the Chabauty/Fell topology (c02, c06); (ii) attaches it via a *scoped* instance on Mathlib's ClosedSubgroup, avoiding c04's global instance on a Mathlib type; (iii) models the target as the subtype {H : ClosedSubgroup G // ¬ IsCompact (H : Set G)} with the subspace topology — verified with pp.explicit that IsEmbedding elaborates to instTopologicalSpaceSubtype over eTopology; (iv) uses Mathlib's ClosedSubgroup (c02 shadows it with a bespoke def); (v) avoids the awkward @IsEmbedding/letI forms of c05/c08 and the redundant generateFrom of an already-topology (c05, c08); (vi) includes API/test lemmas for the bespoke definitions as CONTRIBUTING.md asks. c03/c07 (mkOfNhds) are equivalent and acceptable but c01 is cleaner. Compiles with only the 'declaration uses sorry' warning; shipped verbatim.

namespace Kourovka.«9.47»

open Filter Set Topology
open scoped Pointwise

/--
A topological space `X` is *scattered* if every nonempty subset `A` of `X` has a point
which is isolated in `A`, i.e. a point `x ∈ A` which is not an accumulation point of `A`.
-/
def IsScattered (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Set X, A.Nonempty → ∃ x ∈ A, ¬ AccPt x (𝓟 A)

/-- A space is scattered iff its only preperfect (dense-in-itself) subset is the empty set. -/
@[category API, AMS 54]
theorem isScattered_iff_forall_preperfect {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] :
    IsScattered X ↔ ∀ A : Set X, Preperfect A → A = ∅ := by
  simp only [IsScattered, Preperfect, ← not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
  refine forall_congr' fun A => ⟨fun h hA hne => ?_, fun h hne => ?_⟩

    exact hx' (hA x hx)
  · by_contra h'
    push_neg at h'
    exact h h' hne

/-- A discrete space is scattered. -/
@[category test, AMS 54]
theorem isScattered_of_discreteTopology (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X]

  intro A ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, -⟩, hyx⟩ := accPt_iff_nhds.mp h {x} (isOpen_discrete _ |>.mem_nhds rfl)
  exact hyx hy

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]

/--
The basic $E$-neighbourhood
$$E(H, U, K) = \{X \in L(G) : X \cap K \subseteq HU \text{ and } H \cap K \subseteq XU\}$$
of a closed subgroup `H` of `G`, determined by a subset `U` (a neighbourhood of the
identity) and a subset `K` (a compact set) of `G`.

def eNhd (H : ClosedSubgroup G) (U K : Set G) : Set (ClosedSubgroup G) :=
  {X | (X : Set G) ∩ K ⊆ (H : Set G) * U ∧ (H : Set G) ∩ K ⊆ (X : Set G) * U}

/-- A closed subgroup `H` lies in each of its basic $E$-neighbourhoods `eNhd H U K`, provided

theorem mem_eNhd_self (H : ClosedSubgroup G) {U : Set G} (hU : (1 : G) ∈ U) (K : Set G) :
    H ∈ eNhd H U K :=
  ⟨inter_subset_left.trans (subset_mul_left _ hU),
    inter_subset_left.trans (subset_mul_left _ hU)⟩

    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left).trans

    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans

    · exact (inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_right).trans

That is: for every scattered compact Hausdorff space $X$, do there exist a locally compact
(Hausdorff) group $G$ and a topological embedding of $X$ into the subspace of the lattice
$L(G)$ of closed subgroups of $G$, carrying the $E$-topology, consisting of the
non-compact closed subgroups?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 22 54]
theorem kourovka.«9.47» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X], IsScattered X →
      ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : TopologicalSpace G),
        IsTopologicalGroup G ∧ LocallyCompactSpace G ∧ T2Space G ∧
        ∃ f : X → {H : ClosedSubgroup G // ¬ IsCompact (H : Set G)}, IsEmbedding f := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«9.47»

items: 'Compact' is read as compact Hausdorff (Russian convention, as the decomposition notes say): X carries [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X].
'Locally compact group' is read as a Hausdorff locally compact topological group: IsTopologicalGroup G ∧ LocallyCompactSpace G ∧ T2Space G (standard convention; also matches the notes).

The E-topology is defined exactly per the notes' neighbourhood base: eNhd H U K = {X | X ∩ K ⊆ H * U ∧ H ∩ K ⊆ X * U}, and a set O is declared open iff every H ∈ O has some eNhd H U K ⊆ O with U ∈ 𝓝 1 and K compact. This is the canonical topology determined by a neighbourhood base (Mathlib's mkOfNhds-style reading); whenever the base satisfies the neighbourhood axioms (which holds for locally compact G, the only case the problem uses) it is the unique topology with these basic neighbourhoods. Right translates HU/XU are used as in the notes; using UH/UX instead yields the same topology because conjugation by elements of a compact set is uniformly controlled.

The 'space of closed non-compact subgroups with E-topology' is modeled as the subtype {H : ClosedSubgroup G // ¬ IsCompact (H : Set G)} with the subspace topology of the E-topology on ClosedSubgroup G (installed as a scoped instance in the problem namespace).

'Scattered' is defined as: every nonempty subset A has a point x ∈ A that is not an accumulation point of A (¬ AccPt x (𝓟 A)); an API lemma shows this is equivalent to 'the only Preperfect subset is ∅'.
'Homeomorphically embedded' is IsEmbedding f (inducing + injective), i.e. a homeomorphism onto the image.
Universe choices follow the collection's convention: X : Type and G : Type.
The empty space is (trivially) a scattered compact and trivially embeds; this matches the informal statement.

reviewer_notes: Interpretation follows the decomposition notes: 'compact' = compact Hausdorff, 'locally compact group' = Hausdorff locally compact topological group, 'homeomorphically embedded' = Topology.IsEmbedding into the subspace of non-compact closed subgroups. The E-topology is not in Mathlib and is defined bespoke from the neighbourhood base given in the notes; the choice HU vs UH is immaterial (compact K), and I checked that this topology coincides with the Fell/Chabauty hit-or-miss topology on closed subsets of any topological group (so c02/c06's Chabauty substitute is mathematically equivalent, but the direct definition is more faithful to the source's wording). Scatteredness is defined as 'every nonempty subset has a point that is not an accumulation point of it' (equivalent to the isolated-point and Preperfect-based definitions used by other candidates). Universe convention (X, G : Type) follows the other Kourovka files. Boundary case: empty X embeds trivially; a compact G has no non-compact closed subgroups, so the ∃ G must choose a non-compact group for nonempty X — this is the intended reading. Residual uncertainty is only about whether Protasov's original 1979 definition of the E-topology is literally the neighbourhood base stated in the notes; since it is known to coincide with Chabauty on locally compact groups (Protasov–Tsybenko 1984), the formal content is unaffected.
statement: Is it true that every scattered compact can be homeomorphically embedded into the space of all closed non-compact subgroups with $ E$-topology of a suitable locally compact group?
